format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this character, like "hero". It matches the file name.

body.description: "dynamic" moves and falls; "fixed" stays where it is put.

w.description: How wide the character is, in tiles.

h.description: How tall the character is, in tiles.

size.description: The size of the character, in tiles.

color.description: The colour it is drawn in, as # and six digits, like #e4572e.

upright.description: True if the character stays on its feet and cannot be tipped over. Left out means false.
